description: Stage 5 Seq Login-Audit & Runtime Security Signals and Alert Thresholds ($0 Free Individual/Dev Tier + Prometheus/Grafana OSS parity)

signals.title: Davids — Administrator Account Lockout (Critical)
signals.description: Matches Administrator Identity login attempts rejected due to per-account lockout.

signals.title: Davids — Customer Credential-Stuffing Lockout Spike
signals.description: Matches Customer Identity login attempts rejected due to per-account lockout.

signals.title: Davids — OIDC Authorization-Code / Refresh-Token Replay or State Tampering
signals.description: Matches OpenIddict token grant rejections (single-use code/refresh replay) and tampered authorize request_token values.

signals.title: Davids — Authentication & Gateway Rate-Limiter Rejections (HTTP 429)
signals.description: Matches HTTP 429 rate-limiter rejections emitted by Davids.APIGateway, Identity, and AdminIdentity.

signals.title: Davids — Administrator BFF CSRF Rejections (HTTP 403)
signals.description: Matches cookie-authenticated Admin BFF requests missing valid X-Requested-With: DavidsAdmin or Origin headers.

signals.title: Davids — Falco eBPF Container Runtime Intrusion
signals.description: Matches Falcosidekick CLEF events shipped from the davids Kubernetes namespace.
